what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in South Sudan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5083 Eritrean refugees in South Sudan, 0.9% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia and Sudan host the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Eritrea in these years: an interstate armed conflict with Ethiopia in 2016.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Eritrea.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2015 at 12 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Sudan.
These are year-end totals for South Sudan only, reported to UNHCR.
